title: Design an LFU Cache
description: Simulate a Least Frequently Used (LFU) cache of capacity `c`. Operations: `PUT key val` and `GET key`. When capacity is reached, evict the least frequently used key (ties broken by least recently used).
input_format: First line contains capacity `c` and number of operations `m`. Following `m` lines contain commands.
output_format: Outputs of GET commands separated by space.

sample_tests.explanation: Key 2 is evicted when 3 is added because key 1 was used.

hidden_tests.input:
2 6
PUT 1 1
PUT 2 2
GET 1
PUT 3 3
GET 2
GET 3

hints: Track frequency and access timestamp for each key.
When evicting, select the key with minimum frequency, breaking ties by oldest timestamp.
Update frequency and timestamp whenever a key is accessed via GET or PUT.
